product_metadata.title: Chameleon Colors Holi Color Powder Party Box, 36-Piece Color Party Kit
features: Comes with 24 colors, 4 bright liquid colors, 4 easy-fill squirt guns, and 4 refillable color balls
Packets are easy to open and throw; just add water to liquid color bottle and shake;
Great for holi wars, color powder parties, festivals, school events, birthday parties, and more
Non-toxic, gluten-free, and environmentally safe color powder is easy to clean. Safe for all
Satisfaction Guarantee: Manufacturer guarantee, valid for 30 days in case you are not 100% satisfied
description: Ready for a color party? This 36-piece Holi Color Powder Party Box will provide hours of color fun! The bright and vivid bulk colors are perfect for any birthday party, festival, school event, fun run, office party, color war, family reunion, summer camp, and so much more. Try throwing it with your hands and see the holi colors explode right before your eyes! Or, fill the squeeze bottles with water and the liquid color to have a blast. We've also included four easy-to-fill squirt guns to spray color the liquid color concentrate, too. Last but not least, Chameleon Colors Color Balls are a fun way to spread the joy of color! They're refillable, reusable, and explode with color on impact! Plus, the color powder is easy to clean, especially when used outdoors. The holi powder is not intended to stain clothing - even when you wear white! The holi color powder is also non-toxic, gluten-free, and environmentally friendly, so it's safe for kids and pets. Chameleon Colors takes pride in our product using only the best and safest ingredients. All of our ingredients are FD&C and D&C approved. Made in the U.S.A.
